title: Atlantic δ¹³C-DIC observations, point reconstruction, and 3-D climatology
summary: Construct a quality-controlled Atlantic cruise table, a 152,127-row GLODAPv2.2023 point reconstruction, and a 1-degree 33-depth climatology from public observations and predictors.
evaluation: Evaluation first checks exact delivery, schema, identifiers, coordinates, mask behavior, physical validity, non-degeneracy, reproducibility, and figure readability. Valid formal products are then compared with a trusted expert product and concealed whole-cruise observations. Evaluation proceeds strictly through 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0, stopping at the first failed gate. The 0.4 and 0.6 gates require both expert-product agreement and independent-validation non-inferiority; the 0.8 and 1.0 gates then add strict independent improvement. Private support, values, numerical comparison thresholds, and scoring implementation are not disclosed. Public output-gate safety and non-degeneracy limits are stated explicitly in both Prompt variants and output_contract.json.

scoreSemantics.0.6: Expert-level quality (C tolerance AND B non-inferiority)
scoreSemantics.0.8: Beyond-expert (0.6 gates AND prespecified B improvement)
scoreSemantics.1.0: Stronger improvement (0.8 gates AND second independent axis or stronger frozen B evidence)
